rules: Named paragraph/character style inheritance, direct overrides before/after styles, plain/pard resets, missing definitions, base styles and font controls. Mid-paragraph paragraph-style changes are separately recorded exploration differences.

cases.source: {\rtf1\ansi\ansicpg1252\deff0{\fonttbl{\f0\fnil\fcharset0 Arial;}}{\stylesheet{\s0 Normal;}{\s1\v Hidden;}}\pard\s0 BEFORE\par\pard\s1 SECRET\par\pard\s0 AFTER}
